meaning: Cases on specific earlier days, not window totals.
availability: Planned: calculate from the real NJ balanced onset panel after the counting unit is finalized. Use only history available by the forecast date.

meaning: Calendar position of the forecast origin.
availability: Planned: calculate from the real NJ balanced onset panel after the counting unit is finalized. Use only history available by the forecast date.

definition: Calendar categories for t+h.
meaning: Known calendar conditions on the predicted day.
availability: Planned: calculate from the real NJ balanced onset panel after the counting unit is finalized. Use only history available by the forecast date.

meaning: Recent cumulative new cases.
availability: Planned: calculate from the real NJ balanced onset panel after the counting unit is finalized. Use only history available by the forecast date.

definition: t minus the latest s <= t with a positive recorded-onset count. Zero on positive days; unavailable before the first observed positive day.
meaning: Length of an observed zero-case interval.
availability: Planned: calculate from the real NJ balanced onset panel after the counting unit is finalized. Use only history available by the forecast date.

definition: ACS population; ALAND / 1,000,000; population / land area.
meaning: NJ resident scale, land area and concentration.
availability: Existing reference values; require valid ZIP-to-ZCTA mapping. Population/density are static 2021-vintage inputs. No age or income.

definition: Row sum and column sum of F(i,j) with BOTH i and j in the eligible NJ reference set, including self-links.
meaning: Jobs represented within the selected NJ network.
purpose: Employment scale in a consistently defined network.
availability: Must recompute; these are not total resident/workplace employment across all destinations/origins.

definition: Column and row sums over eligible NJ regions with i != j.
meaning: Commuting connections between different NJ regions.
purpose: Volume of connections beyond normalized weights.
availability: Must recompute from routes with both endpoints in NJ. External means outside the local region, not outside NJ.

definition: F(j,j), residence and work in the same mapped NJ region.
meaning: Within-region jobs.
availability: Reuse after geographic validation; excluded from pressure.

definition: NJ external inflow / workplace_jobs_nj_network; NJ external outflow / resident_jobs_nj_network.
meaning: Dependence on other NJ regions within this network.
availability: Must recompute; zero denominators are unavailable, not zero. Not shares of all actual employment.

definition: F(i,j) / SUM_k F(k,j), where i and k are eligible NJ origins, j is an eligible NJ destination, and k != j.
meaning: Each NJ origin's share of represented external NJ inflow to j.
purpose: Weight for the NJ-only pressure feature.
availability: Route-level auxiliary field; recompute after restricting both endpoints to NJ. Sums to 1 for destinations with positive external NJ inflow.

definition: F(i,j) / SUM_k F(i,k), where k is an eligible NJ destination and k != i.
meaning: Each NJ destination's share of represented external outflow from i.
purpose: Optional network description; not used in inbound pressure.
availability: Route-level auxiliary field; recompute. Not a separate region-day predictor by itself.

definition: SUM_i inbound_weight_nj(i,j) * [SUM_s C(i,t-s) / Population(i) * 100000], s=0,...,w-1, w=7 or 14, i != j.
meaning: NJ commuting-weighted trailing cumulative case rate per 100,000 residents.
purpose: Test whether connected NJ regions improve local forecasts beyond local history.
availability: Planned. NJ-only normalized pressure, different from the old partial NJ contribution under NJ-NY weights. Do not use NY case rates or substitute missing rates with zero.

definition: SUM_i inbound_weight_nj(i,j) over origins with a complete w-day case window and valid positive population.
meaning: Share of represented NJ inbound weight with usable case rates.
purpose: Quality diagnostic; distinguish incomplete source data from observed zeros.
availability: Planned diagnostic for each window. Pressure is unavailable when coverage is incomplete unless an explicitly different partial/renormalized measure is defined. No external inflow: weights and pressure unavailable.
